Usage notes

This page describes cfast, a local Codeforces sample testing tool. The current source and instructions are available in the GitHub repository.

Local results

Passing saved tests does not guarantee acceptance on an online judge. Test coverage, hardware, compiler configuration, special checkers, and resource accounting may differ. The website’s example results are illustrative.

Your code and files

Review commands before running them. cfast compiles and executes your C++ programs; it is not a sandbox for untrusted code. Back up your solutions and custom cases. A full cache reset with cfast clean --all --yes removes custom cases as well as downloaded samples.

Affiliation

cfast is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Codeforces, Competitive Companion, or online-judge-tools. Those names identify the services and tools it works with.
